question: What can be made clearer without pretending clarity is truth?
What becomes visible when ordinary noise falls away?
What survives measurement, rivalry and repetition?
What remains when explanation honestly stops?
What do I freely orient the sacred part of myself toward?
What do I refuse to assume merely because a sacred answer is available?
What can be built, embodied, repaired or tested in matter?
What counts as knowing, experience, memory or another mind?
What exists between minds that no mind owns alone?
